messages:
rachel lee: spotted an OOM on shard-d around 03:20 UTC. memory climbs steadily after 02:50, looks like KV cache never stabilizes after churn.

omar ali: can you attach a heap snapshot and the jemalloc stats?

rachel lee: uploaded to /s3/kv-ooms/1977929999/heap.pb and /s3/kv-ooms/1977929999/jemalloc.json. pprof top shows put/insert dominating allocations.

kevin nguyen: likely small-buffer churn + fragmentation. immediate mitigations I suggest:
- I1: soft per-shard cache cap (owner: kevin) - ETA 18h
- I2: aggressive eviction for entries >128kb (owner: rachel) - ETA 6h
- I3: enable 20s continuous heap sampling for 48h (owner: samir) - ETA 1h
- I4: alert for cache growth >6% in 5m (owner: omar) - ETA 3h

samir patel: ops-bot: Incident 1977929999 created and assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

ops-bot: Incident 1977929999 opened. Priority: P1 (OOM).

rachel lee: will open eviction PR scoped to canary (PR #4301). adding unit test for miss-rate guardrails.

kevin nguyen: implementing soft cap with throttled evictions and telemetry. canary rollout plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50%.

omar ali: I'll add the alert and a dashboard panel for miss-rate vs memory.

samir patel: starting heap sampling now; will upload diffs to the S3 path. also running a small stagings compaction run tonight.

rachel lee: initial repro harness uploaded to my branch to reproduce fragmentation pattern.

kevin nguyen: short-term note: if cap causes miss spike, fallback is routing reads to secondary replica (flag routing.kv.fallback=true).

omar ali: documenting owners in the postmortem follow-up doc and scheduling a 30m sync in 72h.

samir patel: EOD staging compaction numbers: frag index 0.46 -> 0.33, CPU +3%. preliminary but promising.

rachel lee: eviction canary at 04:10 UTC to 2% looks stable so far.

kevin nguyen: summary of tracked items for postmortem doc: I1(kevin,18h), I2(rachel,6h), I3(samir,1h), I4(omar,3h). long-term: L-A slab allocator + arena reuse (samir+kevin, 6w), L-B zero-copy large values (rachel, 3w), L-C synthetic frag CI job (rachel,2w).

omar ali: locking this thread as canonical tracker. please post brief updates here as you hit milestones.

rachel lee: thanks — will update when canary hits 10% and when heap diffs are analyzed.

samir patel: setting weekly "kv-frag-scan" reminder to catch slow regressions.

omar ali: closing thread for now; will reopen if canary fails or new OOMs appear.
